purpose: Monochrome exam-result banner candidates. Four existing Design Lab posters reused; two dark companions generated by editing original geometry.

assets.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather
Asset type: monochrome dark-theme exam-results banner background, landscape 3:2, 1536x1024.
Input image: edit target, original lime nested triangular sculpture poster.
Primary request: create its dark-theme companion. Preserve the exact nested triangular forms, rounded bevels, cutouts, relative arrangement, camera angle, perspective and premium matte 3D material. Keep the artwork clustered at the right edge and lower edge, with the rightmost 30–35% carrying the main geometry and the left 65% a calm, almost flat dark field for overlay text. Do not introduce new shapes.
Scene/backdrop: replace pale light backdrop with deep muted olive charcoal, #292e24 to #343c27. Replace bright daylight with restrained dark studio lighting.
Color palette: one monochrome lime/olive family only. Dark olive forms with controlled soft lime highlights around #d3e38c, no blue, cyan, teal, purple or other accent hues. The left text field stays uniformly dark and quiet.
Constraints: preserve recognizable geometry and high craft of the original. Landscape 3:2. No text, logo, UI, frame, border or watermark. Avoid harsh neon, shiny plastic, busy background, extra decorative objects and bright light areas behind copy.

Use case: lighting-weather
Asset type: monochrome dark-theme exam-results banner background, landscape 3:2, 1536x1024.
Input image: edit target, original lilac folded prism poster.
Primary request: create its dark-theme companion. Preserve the exact folded geometric prism forms, sharp planar edges, relative arrangement, camera angle, perspective and premium matte 3D material. Keep the artwork clustered at the right edge and lower edge, with the rightmost 30–35% carrying the main geometry and the left 65% a calm, almost flat dark field for overlay text. Do not introduce new shapes.
Scene/backdrop: replace pale lilac light backdrop with deep muted violet charcoal, #2e273d to #3b304d. Replace bright daylight with restrained dark studio lighting.
Color palette: one monochrome violet/lilac family only. Dark violet forms with controlled soft lilac highlights around #c5a8f2; remove any cyan/green rim cast, no lime, cyan, teal or other accent hues. The left text field stays uniformly dark and quiet.
Constraints: preserve recognizable geometry and high craft of the original. Landscape 3:2. No text, logo, UI, frame, border or watermark. Avoid harsh neon, shiny plastic, busy background, extra decorative objects and bright light areas behind copy.

quality_review.findings: Dark versions preserve sculpture geometry, camera and placement; background is calm and dark at the left, illumination controlled, and each asset uses its test's lime/olive or violet/lilac family. No text, logo, UI or watermark.
